clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Westfall Lighthouse, Old Murk-Eye prowls the southern coast. His kind revere him, and sailors fear the lethal menace he poses to anyone who wanders near the lighthouse.

Old Murk-Eye prowls the surf around the Westfall Lighthouse, where he is far tougher and more aggressive than the murlocs common along Westfall’s shores. His attacks have brought enough grief to local mariners that the spectral Captain Grayson seeks his death. Grayson offers a bounty for Old Murk-Eye’s pristine scales, hoping to break his hold on the shallows.
